actions.label: lineDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountTypeLine == "percent", MIN(lineGross, lineGross * (MAX(0, discountValueLine) / 100)), IF(discountTypeLine == "fixed", MIN(lineGross, MAX(0, discountValueLine)), 0)), 2)

actions.label: orderDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountType == "percent", MIN(netSubtotal, netSubtotal * (MAX(0, discountValue) / 100)), IF(discountType == "fixed", MIN(netSubtotal, MAX(0, discountValue)), 0)), 2)

actions.label: vatLineDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountTypeLine == "percent", MIN(vatLineGross, vatLineGross * (MAX(0, discountValueLine) / 100)), IF(discountTypeLine == "fixed", MIN(vatLineGross, MAX(0, discountValueLine)), 0)), 2)
